summary: Iteration 6 — validated (1) footer no longer contains 'BUILT ON EMERGENT' (0 occurrences in rendered innerText), (2) Instagram goodmood.fest full share URL wired correctly (data-testid='social-ig-goodmood'), (3) new FactoryMakerStudio IG link (data-testid='social-ig-fms') present + visible, (4) TourDate backend model supports price_cents/currency and syncs to Stripe (product+price+lookup_key gmt_*), (5) POST /api/payments/checkout with tour lookup_key returns valid Stripe cs_ session, (6) Tour public UI switches BILLETS between <button>(paid, internal Stripe) and <a>(external ticket_url), (7) Admin TourForm exposes tour-price-input and tour-currency-input with helper copy. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter6.py. Regressions all green: catalogue 9 volumes with cover_url, 5 seeded tour dates render as external links, newsletter POST fires Resend (live key, log confirms 'email send failed to=...example.com Invalid to field' which is expected Resend test-mode behavior).

issues: public/index.html still contains <title>Emergent | Fullstack App</title> (visible in browser tab) and <meta name=description content='A product of emergent.sh'>. The rendered <body> innerText has 0 'EMERGENT' occurrences (footer text properly removed), but the browser tab title / SEO meta still expose the platform brand. User said 'no mention on the public site' — recommend updating index.html title to 'GOOD MOOD — DJ SAYD' and meta description accordingly. Emergent telemetry scripts (assets.emergent.sh/scripts/emergent-main.js, ap.emergent.sh posthog) also live in <head> — those are Emergent platform injections and may be intentional.
Date field uses browser-native <input type=datetime-local> picker instead of shadcn calendar (minor UX inconsistency with the rest of the design).

POST /api/newsletter -> {ok:true} and Resend actually called (live re_ key)

Landing footer: data-testid='social-ig-goodmood' href EXACTLY matches https://www.instagram.com/goodmood.fest?igsh=MTY5NHp2YnpocHZ3NQ%3D%3D&utm_source=qr

Tour public UI: 5 seeded tour dates (no price_cents) all render as <a data-testid='tour-tickets-{i}'> external links (regression preserved)
Admin login (admin@goodmood.com / GoodMood2026) succeeds, redirects to /admin
Admin TourForm modal renders data-testid='tour-price-input' and 'tour-currency-input' with helper copy explaining the switch behaviour
critical_code_review_comments: public/index.html has hardcoded <title>Emergent | Fullstack App</title> — should be branded per user request
server.py:219 uses `if doc.get('price_cents')` which treats 0 as falsy — a free ticket (price_cents=0) would silently NOT sync to Stripe. Low risk (no zero-price use case yet) but worth noting
server.py is ~660 lines — approaching the 700 split threshold; consider modularising (auth/catalogue/tour/merch/payments/webhook) before further growth
_sync_tour_to_stripe is nearly identical to _sync_product_to_stripe — could be DRY'd into a single helper that takes name/desc/metadata factories
Tour.jsx buyTicket does not surface a friendly localized error toast label; falls back to raw err.response?.data?.detail
Admin TourForm date field uses native input; inconsistent with app's shadcn dark UI language
seed_data_creation: Newsletter subscriber TEST_iter6_regression@example.com; TEST_NoPriceCity and TEST_PriceCity tour dates were created and deleted during tests (cleanup handled in test bodies).
